description: Use this when you have daily kWh, tariffs, and a system size and want classroom energy-bill arithmetic. Do not use this as a quote, a savings guarantee, or a credit offer. Do not send an account or identity number.

battery_kwh.description: Battery nameplate size in kWh. Omit or use 0 for solar only.

daily_kwh.description: Household electricity use in kWh per day, from a recent bill.

export_tariff_aud_per_kwh.description: Feed-in tariff in Australian dollars per exported kWh. Use 0 if unknown.

import_tariff_aud_per_kwh.description: Price paid to import one kWh, in Australian dollars. A usage rate, not the daily supply charge.

peak_sun_hours.description: Average peak sun hours per day. Omit to use 4.2, a mid-range teaching figure for southern Australian capitals, not a site assessment.

performance_ratio.description: Derating for heat, inverter losses, and soiling. Omit to use 0.80.

self_consumption_fraction.description: Share of annual generation used at home before a battery, from 0 to 0.95. Omit to use 0.30.

system_size_kw.description: Solar array size in kilowatts. Household scale only.

name: estimate_bill_savings
title: Estimate bill savings
